full_prompt_en: A square, densely detailed fantasy illustration shows a gray-haired reader in profile, bent over a pale folded sheet. The figure fills the right half of the frame, facing left. A close olive cap covers the crown, while swept-back silver hair follows the ear and neck. The face is sharply modeled in warm ocher and gray, with a lowered eye focused on the paper. A high red collar rises around the neck, and a broad vermilion cloak wraps the shoulder and lower right corner. Dark cuffs enclose the wrists; both hands hold a sheet marked with thin curved lines. On the left, large lobed leaves form an ocher-orange cluster, their edges outlined and their veins picked out with fine dark strokes. Behind the leaves and figure, a near-black brown ground carries delicate engraved panels, narrow rectangular divisions, and a circular ornament at the upper right. A small angular orange shape sits against that ornament. The paper is the lightest surface in the frame and catches the reader's attention as well as the viewer's. Warm light from the upper left lifts the face, the leaf edges, and ridges of the heavy cloth, while the recessed patterning stays dark. Fine crosshatched texture and hairline contours fill the image without flattening its main red and orange masses. A thin black border and the tight crop make the composition feel like an illustrated panel. The pose remains quiet and concentrated, with intricate background marks acting as a measured counterpoint to the broad sweep of the cloak.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、细节密集的幻想插画呈现一位灰发读者侧身弯腰端详浅色折叠纸页。人物占画面右半，朝向左。贴头橄榄色帽覆盖头顶，向后梳的银发顺着耳朵和颈部。面容由暖赭与灰色清楚塑形，低垂的眼睛注视纸面。高红领围住脖颈，宽大的朱红披风包裹肩膀与右下角。深色袖口圈住手腕，双手握着一张画有纤细曲线的纸。左侧大片分瓣叶子聚成赭橘色团块，边缘有线描，叶脉以细深色笔线挑出。叶丛和人物后面，近黑褐色底面带有精细刻纹板块、狭窄矩形分隔，以及右上角的圆形装饰。一个小小棱角分明的橘色形块贴着该装饰。纸页是画面最浅的表面，既承接读者目光，也吸引观者视线。来自左上的暖光提亮脸部、叶缘和厚布料的隆起，凹入的花纹仍留在暗处。细密交叉排线和发丝般的轮廓填满画面，却没有冲淡主要的红橘色块。细黑边框和紧凑裁切使构图像一格插画面板。姿态安静而专注，繁密背景刻痕成为宽阔披风弧线的有节制对位。
style_prompt_en: An intricately drawn fantasy illustration balances broad, matte vermilion and ocher-orange masses against a near-black patterned ground. Contours are thin, firm, and densely worked; fine crosshatching, engraved curls, and repeated rectangular divisions fill dark passages without overwhelming the principal silhouette. Pale cream accents remain small and concentrated, acting as points of focus. Warm directional light skims raised edges and softly models one central form, while recesses stay brown-black. The composition is tightly cropped and framed by a narrow dark margin. Large curved color areas counter the minute linear pattern, producing a deliberate rhythm between rest and ornament. Surface grain suggests printed or hand-inked work over muted paint, with clean separations between luminous warm accents and shadowed texture.
style_prompt_zh: 细致线绘的幻想插画把宽阔哑光朱红和赭橘色块放在近黑色纹样底面前。轮廓线纤细、坚实且刻画密集；细交叉排线、卷曲刻纹与重复矩形分隔填充暗部，却不压过主体剪影。浅奶油色重音面积很小、位置集中，成为视线焦点。暖色定向光掠过隆起边缘，并柔和塑造中央形体，凹处保持褐黑。构图裁切紧密，周围有狭窄深色边框。大片弧形色域与极细线纹相互制衡，形成留白与装饰交替的节奏。表面颗粒带有印制或手工墨线覆盖低饱和颜料的感觉，发亮暖色重音与阴影肌理之间分隔清楚。
theme_en: A red-cloaked reader studying a folded sheet among golden leaves
theme_zh: 红披风读者在金黄叶丛旁端详折叠纸页
name: Michael Hutter
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
